target: Design a deployable workflow for retrieval using a query-to-evidence retriever. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

competency.title: Design retrieval — human review
competency.outcome: Design a deployable workflow for retrieval using a query-to-evidence retriever. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.measure: recall at k and answer support
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: ranking a familiar but irrelevant document

competency.practice_task: Produce a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget grounded in a query-to-evidence retriever.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report recall at k and answer support with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: ranking a familiar but irrelevant document.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of retrieval.
Practice: an independent reviewer can execute its acceptance tests.
Measurement: report recall at k and answer support against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for ranking a familiar but irrelevant document; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
